notableTimingDetail: Same as R0002: no reconnect (no 4th replicaId allocated) occurred before this crash — all three sessions (replicaId 1/2/3) stayed connected throughout. Combined with R0002, this is important evidence AGAINST the hypothesis (raised while investigating R0001/R0002 in real time) that the defect is specific to the mid-session reconnect/snapshot-reseed path: two of three native-injection failures happened with NO reconnect involved at all. The defect must be reachable via plain sustained concurrent real-latency delivery, not only via reconnect. R0004 (which DID involve a reconnect) may be a related-but-distinct mechanism, or the same one — not yet determined.
reproducibilityCaveat: Same Rule 3 deviation as R0001/R0002: raw operationLog for this occurrence was not persisted before teardown. Record is full-fidelity for provenance/pattern-matching, not a byte-exact reproducer.
